description: Stop the currently running workflow on ComfyUI. Optionally pass prompt_id to interrupt only that prompt. If cleanup_after_ms is set (and prompt_id given), after interrupt the tool will poll the queue and remove the prompt from queue if it is still there (frees GPU for next job). Requires COMFYUI_HOST.

cleanup_after_ms.description: If set (and prompt_id given), after interrupt poll queue and remove prompt if still running (e.g. 5000). Helps free GPU after FLUX/interrupt.

prompt_id.description: Optional: interrupt only this prompt if it is running; omit to interrupt current run

name: interrupt_execution
